CHIPS3 in a two-handed division boats join race by race — ISORA 2026, Two-Handed, 18 races, best 5 count

ISORA NoR 5.9 and 7.3: the Two-Handed class is a division within IRC, and a boat races in it for the races it sails two-handed. A race sailed crewed is not a Two-Handed race for the boat: it takes no place in it and is not one of the boats in it, so it scores 0 there, as a boat that didn't come does.

Scoring system: IRC
